hypothesis: Use evolutionary neural architecture search with dynamic prompt adaptation to evolve transformers that adjust in real-time, reducing hallucinations and performance inconsistency
description: This approach applies evolutionary search to discover transformer variants where layer depths and attention patterns can change per input, guided by prompt difficulty signals rather than fixed architectures; by linking structural plasticity to semantic load, it enables models to allocate computational resources where needed, potentially improving robustness and calibration without retraining
raw:
Hypothesis: Neural Architecture Search with evolutionary constraints for dynamic prompt adaptation is used to automatically evolve transformer structures that adjust in real-time to prompt complexity, addressing inconsistent generative performance and reducing hallucination rates  
Description: This approach applies evolutionary search to discover transformer variants where layer depths and attention patterns can change per input, guided by prompt difficulty signals rather than fixed architectures; by linking structural plasticity to semantic load, it enables models to allocate computational resources where needed, potentially improving robustness and calibration without retraining
shortening_steps: Use evolutionary neural architecture search with dynamic prompt adaptation to evolve transformers that adjust in real-time, reducing hallucinations and performance inconsistency

messages.content:
You will be given a research hypothesis in artificial intelligence, consisting of a Method, a Problem, and a Goal.
Rewrite it for a reader who is a researcher but not necessarily an AI specialist, in exactly this format:

Hypothesis: <ONE sentence of 20 to 30 words stating concretely what is done with the method, for which problem, to achieve which goal>
Description: <two or three sentences, 50 to 70 words in total, explaining the mechanism and why it could work>

Rules: the hypothesis sentence must have between 20 and 30 words: if the input is short, make it concrete by stating how the method would be applied; if the input is long, condense it to its core idea; begin the hypothesis sentence directly with the method (never with "This study", "This approach", "We", or similar); use plain, neutral language and at most one technical term per noun phrase; do not exaggerate; do not invent results, numbers, datasets, or citations; do not mention how the hypothesis was obtained; output only the two lines.

Method: Neural Architecture Search with evolutionary constraints for dynamic prompt adaptation
Problem: Generative AI models exhibit inconsistent performance across semantically similar prompts due to static architectural biases
Goal: Automatically evolve transformer architectures that adapt structure in real-time to prompt complexity, improving generalization and reducing hallucination rates
